purpose: Research candidates; native xAuby replay and certification still required for Arena admission.

execution.cost_model: All-in proportional cost: assumed 5 bp taker fee plus 2 bp friction per side; stress adds 5 bp per side. No historical funding or bid/ask reconstruction.
execution.fill_model: Next-bar open market fills; close-based ATR stop/trail and time exits. Stops are not intrabar protection.
execution.end_policy: Flatten signals begin two UTC calendar days before each feed end; require zero remaining open trades.
execution.quantity_note: Current OKX ctVal times lotSz; historical lot-size changes and account-specific fees are not modeled.

selection.tests: Six fixed pair/family candidates on two independent windows; stress only preliminary passers.
selection.rank_by: Holdout net return among passers, with drawdown/trades displayed; this is screening, not certification.
selection.failed_policy: Retain rejected research records; no live allocation.

limits: Six inspected holdouts introduce selection bias; a new untouched forward window is needed
Fixed cost assumptions, no historical funding
Close-based stops may exceed nominal risk within a bar
No xAuby live plugin parity or certification asserted
